newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine crop weather conditions said good.
newsitem.headline: Argentine crop weather conditions said good.

text.p: Argentine farmers are enjoying sunny weather good for crops and helping harvesting, traders and forecasters said Thursday.
"The weather is good. They're out in the fields," one trader told Reuters. He said wheat harvesting was progressing well.
Another trader said "The optimum conditions for soybean are continuing."

The Argentine government's Meteorological Service forecast an overcast day with the possibility of late storms in key Buenos Aires province. Temperatures should rise to a maximum of 28 degrees celsius (82 degrees Fahrenheit) in La Plata.
It forecast an overcast day in La Pampa, with a maximum temperature of 31 degrees celsius (88 degrees Fahrenheit) in Santa Rosa. There was a possibility of storms in Cordoba and Santa Fe provinces.
